messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Serbian (Latin script), guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
I ona se nije pomerala ispred mog lica, naprotiv toliko je ometala moj put, da sam se vraćao više puta okrenuo.
